selection_rule.rmse_family: Holm over all field_x_hour cells per horizon
selection_rule.acc_family: Holm over all field_x_hour cells per horizon
selection_rule.hard_window_family: 95th-percentile bilinear-hard windows with Holm over all field_x_hour cells per horizon
selection_rule.spectral_family: Holm over all field_x_hour cells per metric
selection_rule.physical_family: Holm over all physical diagnostics per horizon-year
selection_rule.temporal_rule: no positive aggregate 95% CI and no Holm-significant field regression for curvature error
selection_rule.seed_rule: paired IFS HRES forecast-anchor win in at least 2/3 seeds and mean no worse
selection_rule.ranking: lexicographic gates; no weighted metric score
selection_rule.strict_dominance: descriptive point-estimate diagnostic: all RMSE, hard-window, ACC, scalar/vector spectral, temporal, and physical cells improve in both years and horizons
